nodes.title: Real-valued characteristic functions are continuous and positive definite

nodes.summary: Let $\varphi : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{C}$ be the characteristic function of a probability measure on $\mathbb{R}$. Then $\varphi$ is continuous, positive definite, and satisfies $\varphi(0) = 1$.
nodes.title: Forward direction of Bochner's theorem

nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{C}$. Then $f$ is continuous, satisfies $f(0) = 1$, and is positive definite, meaning that for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, all points $x_1, \dots, x_n \in \mathbb{R}$ and all coefficients $c_1, \dots, c_n \in \mathbb{C}$ the sum $S = \sum_{i=1}^{n} \sum_{j=1}^{n} \overline{c_i}\, c_j\, f(x_i - x_j)$ is a nonnegative real number, if and only if there is a Borel probability measure $\mu$…
nodes.title: Bochner's theorem

nodes.summary: Let $\mu$ be a probability measure on $\mathbb{R}$ with characteristic function $\varphi_\mu(t) = \int_{\mathbb{R}} e^{itx} \, d\mu(x)$. Then $\varphi_\mu$ is positive definite: for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, all $t_1, \dots, t_n \in \mathbb{R}$ and all $z_1, \dots, z_n \in \mathbb{C}$, the sum $\sum_{i=1}^{n} \sum_{j=1}^{n} \varphi_\mu(t_i - t_j) \, z_i \, \overline{z_j}$ is a nonnegative real number.
nodes.title: Characteristic functions are positive definite

nodes.summary: A function $\varphi : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ is a real-valued characteristic function when its composition with the inclusion $\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{C}$ is a characteristic function, that is, when there is a probability measure $\mu$ on $\mathbb{R}$ with $\int_{\mathbb{R}} e^{itx} \, d\mu(x) = \varphi(t)$ for every $t \in \mathbb{R}$.
nodes.title: Real-valued characteristic functions

nodes.summary: A function $\varphi : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{C}$ is a characteristic function when there is a probability measure $\mu$ on $\mathbb{R}$ whose characteristic function equals $\varphi$, that is, $\int_{\mathbb{R}} e^{itx} \, d\mu(x) = \varphi(t)$ for every $t \in \mathbb{R}$.
nodes.title: Characteristic functions

nodes.summary: A function $\varphi : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ is positive definite when its composition with the inclusion $\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{C}$ is positive definite, that is, when for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, all $t_1, \dots, t_n \in \mathbb{R}$ and all $z_1, \dots, z_n \in \mathbb{C}$, the sum $\sum_{i=1}^{n} \sum_{j=1}^{n} \varphi(t_i - t_j) \, z_i \, \overline{z_j}$ is a nonnegative real number.
nodes.title: Positive definite real-valued functions

nodes.summary: A function $\varphi : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{C}$ is positive definite when for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, all $t_1, \dots, t_n \in \mathbb{R}$ and all $z_1, \dots, z_n \in \mathbb{C}$, the sum $S = \sum_{i=1}^{n} \sum_{j=1}^{n} \varphi(t_i - t_j) \, z_i \, \overline{z_j}$ is real and nonnegative, that is, $\operatorname{Im} S = 0$ and $\operatorname{Re} S \ge 0$.
nodes.title: Positive definite functions

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
